description: Measure camera-to-visible-surface depth for a candidate selected from the CURRENT RGB when range can affect the next decision. The query describes visible category and appearance; spatial words do not constrain an image region. Verify returned boxes and appearance against the intended candidate. Returns candidate locations, annotated evidence, measurement_status and valid_distance_count. Identity, route interpretation and task completion remain model judgments. Distance is camera-to-visible-surface depth rather than horizontal or target-center distance. An empty candidate list or failed call means that no measurement was produced. inconsistent_depth_surfaces invalidates the scalar distance; metric_depth_unavailable means metric depth could not be used.

observation_id.description: Exact observation_id shown on the CURRENT image label.

query.description: Concise visible category and appearance, e.g. brown-walled building. Spatial words are not enforced region constraints; verify candidate boxes.
